derivation: from H5746 (עוּג); also with H3934 (לָעֵג) a table-buffoon, i.e.

occurrences.text: And she said, As the Lord thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
